### Lord Over His Brothers
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/lord-over-his-brothers
Passage: Genesis 42:1-6
Points:
- Severe famine in Canaan compels Jacob to send his ten older sons to Egypt to purchase grain.
- Jacob keeps Benjamin at home, demonstrating persistent favoritism and fear of another tragic loss.
- The brothers unknowingly bow before Joseph, beginning the fulfillment of his childhood dreams.
- What appears to be a chance meeting is orchestrated by God's sovereign providence.
- Believers can take comfort that God governs all circumstances to accomplish His good purposes.
